rules: G3 PRESENT is PROCEED, G3 MISSING is STOP, and G3 UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON is REVIEW.
G6, G8, or G11 non-PRESENT is REVIEW when no STOP exists.
G1, G2, G4, G5, G7, G9, or G10 non-PRESENT is STOP.
All gates PRESENT makes the preparation verdict PROCEED.
PROCEED never initiates or validates a transaction.
